context.purpose: Fit a small numeric calibration or explanatory model and decide whether actual finite training/held-out fit/prediction results meet named requirements.
context.assumptions: Unweighted additive numeric ordinary least squares. Rows use declared predictor order followed by observed response, with plain unit labels. Fixed native symbols and vanilla Rscript; fresh RDS replay, independent QR verification.
context.constraints: One to eight predictors, four to 512 training rows and optional one to 512 separate held-out rows. Training rows exceed coefficient count; full rank and actual scaled rectangular infinity-norm condition at most1e6. No categorical/missing values, arbitrary formulas/scripts/models, weights, interactions, confidence intervals or inference/generalisation guarantee.
context.inspection: Review coefficients with original predictor/response units in regression-summary.json, actual training/held-out residuals in CSV and each signed requirement margin/worst sampled condition. Native comparison uses relative1e-10 plus128*ULP(max training response magnitude)*max(1,scaled condition), recorded explicitly; acceptance does not certify below that fidelity limit.
context.recovery: RANK_DEFICIENT_DATA/ILL_CONDITIONED_DATA/INSUFFICIENT_DATA need independent predictors and a supported design. INVALID_REQUIREMENT needs valid scopes/indices/bounds. FIT_REQUIREMENT_NOT_MET retains valid fit evidence and needs review of data/model or justified requirements then a fresh attempt. Configure qualified Rscript for INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND; retain logs for native faults.

workflow.scope: Verified numeric prediction/fit tables into Calc with preserved numeric columns and independently checked workbook values.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure values and explicit finite analytic visits; each visit independently validates native fit and requirements.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers fit, saved-model reopen and final independent CPU verification; shared native kit has a separate bounded watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process cancellation covers native stages; cancellation is checked again before successful publication.
lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/effective plans, canonical numeric inputs, fixed native worker, launcher/input bindings, model.rds, native tables/runtime records, stage stdout/stderr/submissions and failed/success results.
lifecycle.verification: Independent column-scaled Householder QR reconstructs coefficients/predictions/residuals; actual rectangular infinity-norm condition from QR unit-vector solves gates unsupported designs. Compare native model rank/df, fit values and fresh-process RDS replay; recompute finite requirements from checked native values. Launcher/source/model bindings reject stale readback even with refreshed ordinary hashes. Retained regular descriptor reads are nonblocking and bounded8MiB.

losses: Coefficient labels and physical unit meaning require accompanying summary.
Finite authored rows only; no physical or generalisation guarantee.

losses: No causal inference, confidence intervals, p-values or continuous/future prediction proof.
